texts/city-names.md.vizag: The east-coast port, bombed on 7 April 1942 by aircraft from the carrier Ryūjō, which set off an exodus from the town.
texts/city-names.md.benares: The pilgrimage city on the Ganges. The city itself was British territory; the maharaja's state around it, drawn inside the United Provinces here, was recognised as a princely state only in 1911.
